environment.app: production builds with identical optional React profiling and content-ready probes
environment.browser: same signed-in desktop in-app browser, unthrottled
environment.cache: warmed assets, new document/router/query state per startup sample
environment.server: separate loopback ports, same configured database, scheduled jobs disabled
environment.deviceReferenceOnly: OnePlus Nord 4; physical-device after measurements not collected
environment.startupSamples: six alternating samples per build; warm-up samples excluded
environment.navigationSamples: three first visits per page/build, following a new verified dashboard document
environment.freshness: wait for per-document content-ready DOM marker; filter console entries by origin and navigation start timestamp

limitations: Content-ready includes hydration and can occur after the first SSR paint.
Response-start includes same-origin redirects, unlike responseStart minus requestStart.
The samples are small and network variance remains; these are descriptive medians.
This is not an installed Android PWA launch, hosted dashboard Lighthouse result, or a fresh browser profile.
Time-tracking median improvement is too small to establish a meaningful speedup.
Navigation preload's real cold-worker benefit is not quantified by these warm desktop samples.
